SpaceX's Starship Completes 13th Test Flight, Deploys Satellites

SpaceX conducted its 13th test flight of the Starship rocket from Texas on Friday. During the mission, the company successfully deployed its first upgraded Starlink satellites. While the launch and satellite deployment were successful, the booster experienced an imperfect landing.
